🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5); justification: very weak sector breadth plus concentrated tech leadership and large-cap divergences (multiple major names showing 1W vs 1M conflict) support a CAUTION regime.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +14.48%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples and Industrials under pressure: EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Materials and select cyclicals.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND; watch RECOVERY signals at PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) and IBM (1W: +7.76% | 1M: -9.94%) RECOVERY as short-term bounces amid broader caution and major-cap divergences.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is mixed: software and select platforms leading while semiconductors/equipment are weak; examples: ADBE (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +7.84% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND versus ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are under pressure on the 1W: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND and broad sector 1W weakness; pockets of bullish sentiment exist (MA), but overall Financials remain a laggard this week.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing soft 1W performance with selective resilience: PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION and JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION contrast with LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND — defensive names are not broadly leading.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and software names exhibiting clear ABOVE TREND behavior (MPC, VLO, INTU, NOW) and reduce exposure to stocks with confirmed BELOW TREND large-cap breakdowns (AAPL, GOOGL, JPM); style: mixed but with a growth/momentum tilt concentrated in a narrow tech cohort — maintain position sizing discipline given CAUTION.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION, UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +8.90%) showing the broadest strength among sectors. BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples (Materials 1W: -6.92% | 1M: -5.40%) remain weak and warrant monitoring.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND for retention of 1M gains as a risk-on signal; AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND—failure to stabilize would confirm further downside; JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND—regain of weekly momentum required to shift Financials outlook.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (+80): PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION — positive obesity approval headlines but price is down on the week, a divergence to monitor. MA (+55): MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY — partnership news aligns with 1W strength, confirming near-term accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PLTR (-55): PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but strong price action indicate distribution risk despite momentum. NVDA (-50): NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines contrasting with price strength, watch for follow-through. WMT (-55): WMT (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND — negative sentiment confirmed by price weakness.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a growth/momentum tilt due to narrow tech leadership. INTU ABOVE TREND, NOW ABOVE TREND and MPC ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: very thin breadth and major-cap divergences (AAPL, GOOGL, JPM BELOW TREND vs. strong software winners and bearish headlines on PLTR/NVDA) — monitor for trend break and news-driven distribution.
